title: PORTA: Systematic Discovery of Vulnerabilities in Identity Brokers
abstract: arXiv:2611.33015v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Identity brokers such as Keycloak, Vault, and Dex translate authentication proofs from an upstream identity provider into sessions for downstream services. Due to their central role in authentication and trust mediation, a single vulnerability in a broker compromises every downstream service behind it. In fact, recent incidents have demonstrated that even widely adopted platforms are not immune to such issues, highlighting the critical need for systematic analysis. To build such an analysis, this work first defines invariants for broker operation. These invariants are not completely covered by existing authentication specifications, primarily because brokers are unique in their duality, i.e., acting simultaneously as a relying party and an identity provider. The invariants capture the properties that identity brokers must uphold throughout their workflows, as all 60 previous CVEs we consider violate at least one invariant. Within these

translated_title: PORTA: 身份代理中漏洞的系统性发现
translated_abstract: 身份代理（如Keycloak、Vault和Dex）将来自上游身份提供商的身份验证凭证转换为下游服务的会话。由于身份代理在身份验证和信任中介中处于核心地位，代理中的一个漏洞就会危及其背后的所有下游服务。事实上，最近的安全事件表明，即使是广泛采用的平台也无法免受此类问题的影响，这凸显了进行系统性分析的迫切需求。为了构建这样的分析，本工作首先为身份代理的运行定义了不变量。这些不变量并未被现有的身份验证规范完全覆盖，主要是因为身份代理具有独特的双重性，即同时充当依赖方和身份提供商。这些不变量刻画了身份代理在整个工作流程中必须遵守的属性，因为我们所考察的全部60个既往CVE都至少违反了其中一个不变量。在此基础之上……
tldr: 本论文提出PORTA，首次通过定义刻画身份代理“同时作为依赖方和身份提供商”这一独特双重性的运行不变量，实现了对身份代理漏洞的系统性发现，且所考察的全部60个既往CVE均至少违反一个不变量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PORTA, the first systematic approach for discovering vulnerabilities in identity brokers by defining operational invariants that capture brokers' unique duality of acting simultaneously as a relying party and an identity provider, with all 60 previously known CVEs violating at least one invariant.
